fusions.name: Barnacled Edge
fusions.desc: A strike with the reef-crusted blade that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Silt Cast
fusions.desc: Hurls a spadeful of dredged seabed that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug Tidepool
fusions.desc: Digs a pool where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Causeway

riders.text: you cross it faster than open ground
and you mend while you stand on it
and blows find you less often out on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, from silver your health recovers 12% faster on it, and from gold your dodge chance is 8% higher on it.
